# SEOryon Schema & FAQ Generator

> Free, browser-based generator for valid JSON-LD structured data. Pick a type —
> FAQ, Article, Product, LocalBusiness, HowTo, Organization, Person, WebSite,
> BreadcrumbList, Event — fill a simple form, and get a ready-to-paste JSON-LD
> script tag. No signup, no upload, nothing sent to a server. Built by SEOryon.

The generator runs entirely client-side; nothing you type ever leaves the page.
Field templates follow schema.org definitions and Google's documented required and
recommended fields. It makes no rich-result promise — Google restricted FAQ rich
results to government and health sites in 2023 and removed them for all sites in
May 2026 — the real value is clean, machine-readable data that AI engines and
search engines can extract and cite.

## Docs

- [The generator](https://schema.seoryon.com): the tool itself — pick a type, fill the form, copy the JSON-LD
- [How it works](https://schema.seoryon.com/#how): from a simple form to valid, paste-ready structured data
- [Why structured data](https://schema.seoryon.com/#why): what schema does now that FAQ rich results are gone
- [FAQ](https://schema.seoryon.com/#faq): validity, where to paste, and data safety
